document.title: Rework AGENTS.md with T3 ideas
document.summary: AGENTS.md keeps its Comprehende content and adopts the T3 structure: who-is-who, pipeline, file map, footguns, checklists, and verify and docs rules.
document.why: The user likes the T3 Code AGENTS.md and wants the useful parts in this repo.

groups.title: AGENTS.md borrows the T3 shape
groups.why: The new sections give agents the same guardrails T3 relies on, so this file stays short and stops common mistakes.
groups.summary: AGENTS.md gains voice rules, work pipeline, directory map, footguns, done-checklist, verify rules, docs rules, and PR guardrails, all in the T3 shape.
